support_jamie: Hey team — ACME (acct acme-inc) escalated: objects that should have been deleted per their custom retention are still searchable >48h after TTL. Legal wants a preservation window while we investigate. Can someone confirm if deletion jobs actually ran? KMS key rotation happened last week, could that matter?

nora_legal: Thanks, Jamie. We need preservation asap — customer served a legal hold. Please provide sample object IDs, API calls used, and any deletion job logs. Mark this P0 for compliance.

support_jamie: Sample IDs: obj-8a3f, obj-8a4b, obj-8a5c. Repro steps I used:

```bash
# delete request
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/delete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"object_id":"obj-8a3f"}'

# check deletion status
curl -s -X GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj-8a3f -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN"
```

Responses: delete accepted -> {"status":"accepted","deletion_id":"del-9001"} but GET returns 200 and payload includes "visible":true and "deleted":true. Search API returns it in results.

Log snippet from deletion worker (sanitized):
```
2026-02-25T14:03:12Z INFO queued deletion del-9001 for obj-8a3f
2026-02-25T14:03:13Z INFO processed deletion del-9001 tombstone written
2026-02-25T14:03:13Z INFO deletion job acked
```

support_jamie: Customer says objects were visible in UI and via search for 48+ hours after tombstone time. They want either immediate preservation or a way to export current visible state for evidence.

infra_eli: @support_jamie thanks. First checks: was there any delayed indexer backfill or reindex triggered during key rotation window? If KV cache had old encryption context, reindex could fail to drop docs from search. I'll check the indexer logs and KMS key ops.

eng_sre_marc: quick SQL check you can run (unless org policy forbids):
```
SELECT id, deleted_at, tombstone_flag FROM objects WHERE id IN ('obj-8a3f','obj-8a4b','obj-8a5c');
```
If deleted_at is set but tombstone_flag=true and search still returns it, that's an index lag. If deleted_at is NULL then deletion did not persist.

eng_sre_marc: I just checked DB for those ids in prod-read-replica: deleted_at is set for all three (~2026-02-25T14:03Z). tombstone_flag=1. That indicates the deletion was persisted. So likely search index didn't drop or there's a visibility mode showing tombstones.

audit-bot: Automated export created: /exports/2026-02-25/acme-visible-objects-1762345000.tar.gz (request by support_jamie). Contains current search results + object metadata snapshot.

nora_legal: Good. We need that export delivered to Legal S3 and forensics access. Also request a short statement: did any key rotation or HSM activity occur in the 24h before/after deletion? That might impact ability to produce decryptable copies.

infra_eli: There was a KMS rotation on 2026-02-24 22:10Z; HSM wrapped keys cycled then. Key-ops confirmed wrapped keys exported and new keys active. No errors reported in key-ops logs but I'll ask for the key export artifact and check for any rewrap failures.

eng_sre_marc: For immediate mitigation, we can do one of two things: 1) snapshot the logical objects table for acme-inc and mark an internal preservation flag so downstream deletion workers skip them until legal clears — needs infra approval; or 2) re-run a targeted reindex that respects tombstone flags and ensures search no longer returns tombstones (safer, faster). Option 2 preferred unless legal demands stop-all-deletes.

nora_legal: Legal requests a preservation hold on the dataset (stop-of-delete) until we can hand off export. We prefer not to reindex away evidence until legal confirms. Please advise risks/rollback.

infra_eli: Stopping deletes for an account is high-risk if done globally; it will grow storage and affect billing. We can implement account-scoped preservation toggle (fast patch) but need a runbook and approval. Estimated 2-4 hours to patch + testing. If Legal absolutely insists on immediate stop, confirm with Legal Ops and Security that account-level hold is acceptable.

support_jamie: I asked Legal Ops for confirmation now. Customer also asked if their billing would be impacted; they want to know if preservation will increase charges.

nora_legal: We will inform the customer: preservation may incur extra storage; billing changes should be discussed with support. For now, I approve the account-scoped preservation toggle for acme-inc pending Security sign-off. Please document steps and expected ETA.

eng_sre_marc: Next steps I'm going to run: 1) take a snapshot of objects table for acme-inc 2) run targeted reindex to ensure search honors tombstone_flag but keep snapshot untouched 3) provide reindex logs and verification that search no longer returns those ids. If Legal still wants preservation, infra_eli to flip account hold. I'll start step 1 now.

infra_eli: Noted. Security: @security-team please ack for account-scoped hold. Also I'll collect KMS key export artifacts and check for any rewrap failures.

support_jamie: Customer update: told them export is in progress and legal requested hold. They're okay waiting for confirmation. :eyes:

nora_legal: Thanks all. Please attach reindex logs + export link when ready so Legal Ops can package evidence.

eng_sre_marc: Will attach logs + small verification script you can run against export to show checksum + deletion timestamps. Script example: `python verify_export.py --export /exports/... --ids obj-8a3f,obj-8a4b,obj-8a5c`

infra_eli: KMS key-ops responded — no rewrap failures reported for acme-inc keys; export of wrapped keys available at secure vault link (shared with security). I'll post confirmation once Security gives hold OK. :thumbsup: 

support_jamie: Leaving this thread open while we wait for Security/Legal Ops. If anyone needs me to run extra repros or provide tokens, ping here.

nora_legal: Acknowledge. Marking P0 and legal-hold in our tracker. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
